description: The line plot titled "BBQ" illustrates the relationship between the number of demonstrations and accuracy for different models. The x-axis, labeled "#Demonstrations," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick labels at intervals of 250 demonstrations. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," is also a linear scale ranging from 45 to 55, with tick labels at intervals of 5 accuracy points. The plot features four lines representing different models: "Squared Exponential," "Tanh," "ELU," and "LLaMA-2-chat-7B." The "Squared Exponential" line is solid and colored blue, starting at an accuracy of approximately 55 and remaining constant across the x-axis. The "Tanh" line is also solid and blue, starting at an accuracy of around 50 and showing a slight increase to just above 50 by the end of the x-axis. The "ELU" line is dashed and blue, beginning at an accuracy of about 50 and remaining steady throughout. The "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" line is dotted and blue, starting at an accuracy of around 45 and showing a slight increase to just below 50 by the end of the x-axis.
